reason: Selected as the working segmentation for positive-tenure customers. The six-cluster log-scaled solution provides distinct spending and promotion-purchasing profiles, with minimum seed-pair ARI of approximately 0.993 and minimum subsampling ARI of approximately 0.975. The three-cluster solution is useful but too coarse for the intended targeted marketing analysis. The five-cluster solution showed a substantial subsampling instability. The six-cluster PCA alternative produced similar profiles without a clear practical advantage sufficient to justify the additional compression layer. Zero-tenure customers remain pending and are not assigned automatically.
